lines.trans: Well, Katya, how is our chef doing there?
The doctors said everything is fine, he will live.
Honestly speaking, I was so scared for him.
Listen, do you want me to cheer you up?
Sit down here for a minute and take a look.
Those jokers Fedya and Senya pranked Lyova and me.
They were writing messages to me from his phone.
Oh, the screen disappeared, I pressed something.
